architectureProjects.title: Harbor House
architectureProjects.alt: Modern architecture home with warm timber facade
architectureProjects.brief: A quiet waterfront home shaped by long views, natural light, and a warm timber exterior. The plan opens toward the harbor while keeping intimate spaces sheltered from the wind.

gallery.alt: Modern house interior with natural materials

architectureProjects.title: North Courtyard
architectureProjects.brief: A compact urban home organized around a planted courtyard. The shared garden brings daylight into the center of the plan and creates a calm transition from street to home.

gallery.alt: Minimal home with a garden view

architectureProjects.title: Moss Pavilion
architectureProjects.alt: Minimal pavilion architecture in landscaped setting
architectureProjects.brief: A small public pavilion designed as a threshold between garden and city. A simple timber frame and filtered light give the space a gentle presence in its landscape.

architectureProjects.title: Stone Line
architectureProjects.alt: Hotel facade with stone details and outdoor seating
architectureProjects.brief: A hospitality project rooted in Lisbon's material palette. Existing stonework is paired with restrained interventions, creating welcoming public rooms that feel connected to the surrounding streets.

gallery.alt: Quiet hospitality interior with natural light

architectureProjects.title: Atrium House
architectureProjects.alt: Luxury villa with courtyard and sculptural architecture
architectureProjects.brief: A contemporary villa centered on a generous atrium. The courtyard brings greenery into daily life and connects the shared living spaces with quieter private rooms.

gallery.alt: Villa interior opening to a courtyard
